intent: Trace the daily confirmed COVID-19 cases in India over the period from March 2020 through April 2021 to determine how the seven-day moving average changed across the months.

requirements.question: Are all required line series shown in every declared panel?
How did the seven-day moving average of daily confirmed COVID-19 cases in India change across the months from March 2020 through April 2021?

units.claim: All 1 required series appear in panel single chart.
accept: every required series is visible and correctly labeled in this panel
reject: series assigned to the wrong panel

units.claim: The seven-day moving average of daily confirmed COVID-19 cases in India rose from 4.5613 thousand in March 2020 to a local peak of 86.7381 thousand in October 2020, then declined to 15.7921 thousand at an unlabeled point between February and March 2021 before rising to 369.5175 thousand at the final plotted point after the last explicit March 2021 anchor.
units.computation: Start: 4.5613 at point_order 1 (Mar 2020). Local peak: 86.7381 at point_order 101 (Oct 2020). Subsequent minimum: 15.7921 at point_order 164, after the last February anchor and before the March anchor. Final plotted value: 369.5175 at point_order 200, after the last explicit March anchor at point_order 172.
accept: Describes a rise from March 2020 to a peak in October 2020.
Places the subsequent trough at 15.7921 thousand between February and March 2021.
States that the final plotted value is 369.5175 thousand after the last explicit March 2021 anchor.
reject: Claims a monotonic increase throughout the period.
Places the October 2020 peak near 97.15 thousand.
Labels the final point as an explicitly printed April 2021 value.

optional_valid: Mentions that the final value (369.52 thousand) is the maximum shown in the table.
Mentions that the March 2020 value (4.56 thousand) is the minimum shown in the table.
unsupported_to_avoid: Causal explanations for the rise or fall (e.g., variants, lockdowns) not present in the table.
Exact daily values beyond the monthly anchors provided.
Comparisons with other countries or regions.
review_notes: The table provides monthly anchor points plus a final point at point_order 200; the trend unit uses these anchors to summarize the overall change.
The final point has an empty x label but is included as the end of the period (April 2021) based on the intent and point_order 200.
